name: rate-monotonic
description: Rate Monotonic on three periodic tasks with utilization U = 4/12 + 3/24 + 5/48 = 0.5625, below the 3-task Liu & Layland bound n(2^(1/n)-1) = 0.7798. RM assigns priorities from periods (shorter = more urgent); every job meets its deadline. The analysis layer also reports the theoretical bound next to the measured misses.
